# WebsiteAbonnementen

WebsiteAbonnementen (abonnement.website) is a Dutch B2B SaaS platform offering professional website subscriptions for small and medium-sized businesses. Plans start at €49/month and include design, hosting, maintenance, and support. No setup fees, billed per quarter.

## Important pages

- https://abonnement.website/ — Homepage with pricing, add-ons, and FAQ
- https://abonnement.website/betaalbare-professionele-website — Landing page for affordable professional website subscriptions, targeting Dutch SMBs seeking an all-in-one website solution
- https://abonnement.website/offerte — Request a custom quote for tailor-made projects
- https://abonnement.website/privacy — Privacy policy
- https://abonnement.website/terms — Terms and conditions

## About

WebsiteAbonnementen provides three subscription tiers (Starter, Professional, Business) covering website design, hosting, content updates, SEO, and optional add-ons such as Google Ads management, Meta Ads management, e-commerce modules, and social media management. The service targets Dutch-speaking businesses looking for a hassle-free all-in-one website solution.
